stories.headline: Standard Bots launches AI stack to improve industrial robot performance
stories.summary: Standard Bots, a maker of industrial robots, introduced an AI system that uses pretrained models to learn factory tasks from demonstrations. The system is refined with real-world corrections, focusing on data quality rather than sheer data volume.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows how AI can boost productivity and adaptability of manufacturing robots without needing massive data sets.

stories.headline: New evaluation measures AI progress on human algorithmic innovation
stories.summary: Researchers introduced InnovationEval to test whether AI models can independently discover novel machine learning techniques comparable to human work. Early results show that recent frontier models struggle with this task despite having access to substantial GPU compute.
stories.whyItMatters: This evaluation helps researchers better understand the current limits of AI in generating truly novel scientific and algorithmic breakthroughs.

stories.headline: Maritime launches cloud infrastructure for scaling AI agents
stories.summary: Maritime has launched a managed cloud platform that gives individual AI agents persistent computer environments. The service helps developers scale large fleets of agents to millions of users.
stories.whyItMatters: Dedicated cloud infrastructure simplifies the operational hurdles involved in running large numbers of persistent AI agents in production.

stories.headline: Nextech integrates agentic AI tools into electronic health records
stories.summary: Nextech has integrated conversational AI tools from Assort Health and EliseAI into its specialty healthcare platform. The tools automate patient access workflows such as appointment scheduling and intake to reduce administrative workloads.
stories.whyItMatters: Integrating specialized agents into electronic health record systems helps streamline front-office operations for healthcare providers.

stories.headline: Sona8 develops AI voice agents for employee surveys
stories.summary: Sona8 has introduced a platform that uses AI voice agents to conduct employee surveys. The system acts as a context layer that gathers workplace insights directly from staff feedback.
stories.whyItMatters: Voice-based AI agents provide a scalable way to collect qualitative feedback and operational context from employees.
